<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The formula C₁₁H₁₄O₂S has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 210.07145 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value, and yields a reasonable DBE (5). No other common elemental combinations match the mass as closely. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H14O2S.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2S</final_answer>
